fato_historico: 1936: Prime Minister of Greece Ioannis Metaxas suspends parliament and the Constitution and establishes the 4th of August Regime.
energia_do_dia: Today, you may feel an urge to rewrite your inner rules and establish a new regime of self-care. Just as history once shifted its foundation, perhaps you are ready to suspend old habits that no longer serve your creative spirit. Embrace this quiet strength to build a personal sanctuary where your intuition flows freely toward your most cherished dreams.
frase_do_dia: True power lies in the wisdom of your gentle, flowing soul.
significado_numero: The number of solid foundations and building new, steady dreams.
conselho: Consider letting go of old structures to bloom in your own authentic way.
